description: List what CISA has published recently — its combined advisory feed, its alerts feed, or its ICS advisory feed. Each feed is a rolling window of exactly 30 items with no history, no pagination, and no date-range query, so the window's coverage varies from about a week to about two months depending on the feed. For ICS advisory history beyond the window, use cisa_search_ics_advisories, which covers the full corpus back to 2010.

feed.description: Which feed to read: advisories (all.xml, ~8 days of coverage), alerts (alerts.xml, ~8 weeks), or ics (ics-advisories.xml, ~2.5 weeks).

limit.description: Maximum items to return. The 30 ceiling is the upstream window, not a server choice.

since.description: Keep only items published on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD. Filters within the fetched window; it cannot reach back beyond it.

name: cisa_get_alerts

effectiveQuery.description: The since filter as applied, and how many window items it excluded.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `feed_unavailable`: The feed fetch failed or returned a body that carried no RSS channel. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

feedTitle.description: The channel title the feed declares.

feedUrl.description: The absolute feed URL this window came from.

items.description: Items from the current window, newest first as published.

advisoryId.description: Present for ICS advisory items; chains straight into cisa_get_advisory.

guid.description: The upstream guid — a node path such as /node/25513, not a URL and not a permalink.

link.description: Absolute URL of the canonical page for the item.

pubDate.description: Publication timestamp, ISO 8601. Upstream publishes RFC 822 with a two-digit year.

summary.description: Item description with HTML stripped and entities decoded, capped at 1,200 characters.

summaryTruncated.description: True when the summary was capped.

title.description: Item title, trimmed — upstream carries trailing whitespace.

notice.description: Guidance when the since filter excluded every item.

truncated.description: True when the limit capped the returned items.

itemCount.description: Items returned after limit and since were applied.

newest.description: Publication date of the newest item in the fetched window; null when empty.

oldest.description: Publication date of the oldest item in the fetched window; null when empty.

upstreamWindowSize.description: Items the upstream feed serves — a fixed ceiling, not a server choice.

windowCaveat.description: That the feed has no history, no pagination, and no date query.

title: cisa_get_alerts
